How to make money with AI by starting a real business — in a matter of weeks (the honest version) The exact path to making money with AI by starting a real business — no bank-account screenshots, no rich-by-Friday. Here's the whole thing: FIRST, THE CHOICE → there isn't one way, there are two — and most people who quit picked the wrong path, not the wrong dream. Path 1: the solutions business — find businesses with a boring painful problem (missed follow-ups, unanswered reviews, chased invoices), get on calls, sell the fix. Path 2: the product — build one simple thing that kills one pain, make videos about it, sell it to anyone. Scalable, no sales calls. BUILD THE DEMO → before you have a customer. Some people take a lesson, build it on their OWN use case, and in a day have a working demo. It stacks: walk into any call with a library — "oh, I've got something for that. Want to see it run?" SOLUTION FIRST, TOOLS SECOND → customers don't buy tools, they buy solutions. See the obstacle, design the system, then the technology. A tool without a solution behind it builds something that breaks. TWO ENGINES → outreach (not spraying — AI wires the tools that find the RIGHT people and personalize) or content (talk daily about the problem you solve; they reach out to you). CONSISTENCY, DONE RIGHT → two people at the same gym every day: one grinds for years eating trash — barely changes. One measures everything, adjusts, iterates — gets there every time. Same gym, same effort: one understands the system. Business is exactly this — the game pays out in month two, and most people quit in week three. MEASURE → a simple sheet: what you sent, posted, who replied. Dead numbers after a month or two = diagnose: the product, the message, or the people. Fix one, run again. #aiagents #makemoneywithai #aiautomation
